svg.title: Capabilities: answers with sources, every company site, booking, news, help center, pre-call briefs, team replies, learning, voice, alerts and safety

g.font-family: Inter, 'SF Pro Display', 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
g.text: Everything visitors and the team need, in one messenger
a polite refusal, never a guess
LakeB2B and SPAN, fresh every 6 h,
searched live when something is new
guests, a Zoom link, a calendar invite
A featured story, a row per feed,
Sooner after a change, rarer when
by meaning, written from the site
Who they are, what they read, and
a lead score with a reason per point
Answer from the console; it lands
in the visitor's chat or inbox
A mic button and hands-free calls,
news checks, with an alert email
Rate limits, a spend cap, signed links,
nightly backups, a saved email queue
